questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.topic: Sleep and Altered States: What Makes a State a State
questions.learningObjective: Define an altered state of consciousness
questions.stem: A city planner's memo asks what makes a state altered; which feature is central?

options.text: A temporary change in mental functioning

questions.explanation: An altered state is a temporary change in mental functioning, not a lesion, skill, or trait. It is reversible and state-dependent.

questions.stem: The memo orders a continuum from coma to full alertness; which comes after drowsy?
questions.explanation: The continuum rises from coma through drowsy to full alertness. Full alertness follows drowsy. Coma and anesthesia are lower or induced.
